title: REQ · BootScene plays character animations and the transition on React events
summary: BootScene handles playAnimation and transitionTo from the React bus
description: Context: events.ts declares playAnimation {target,name} and transitionTo {sceneId} but BootScene never subscribes. Desired behavior: BootScene subscribes in create(), plays the requested character animation then returns to idle, replays the scene fade for transitionTo, and unsubscribes on SHUTDOWN. Expected result: Phaser reacts to React commands. Why: lets game actions animate the scene.
acceptance_criteria: Given a character with an interact animation, when playAnimation {target:'boy',name:'interact'} is emitted, then the boy sprite plays the interact animation key and replays idle on ANIMATION_COMPLETE
Given a transitionTo event, when it is emitted, then the camera fadeIn is called with the authored transition duration
Given the scene has shut down, when playAnimation or transitionTo is emitted, then nothing is played

in_scope: Per-character play method keyed by id

definition_of_done: BootScene handles both events and releases them on shutdown
